limitations: Only 11 full-read files counted; HTTP/facade/FrontPageGateway supporting references not covered solely by this work. Profile source catalog, binary assets and rights/source correspondence remain boundary checks.
Import script is not run: it performs external queries and writes bundled resource files. No QQ or WeChat calls and no production user data accessed; test outputs omit bundled display names.
Image header/size checks are not complete image decoding, moderation or actual rendering. Injected Response/fetch and synthetic clocks do not establish real network timeout behavior.

Merchant HTTP operations remain registered, but no active Cocos merchant page found in targeted callsite search. Whether this is intended external API or retired capability needs whole-boundary analysis, not an automatic zombie-code claim.

getConsole.grantedPoints covers only its latest 50 returned grants, daily limits use process-local midnight, and merchantContext prioritizes owned merchant over employment. Without an established multi-merchant/statistical/timezone contract these observations are not promoted to confirmed defects.
